opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a strong track record, based in a UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position, with teaching and admin duties.
opportunities.summary: Cross‑disciplinary, curiosity‑driven research funding for established independent researchers to pursue interdisciplinary projects.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicants must be ordinarily resident in the UK, hold a current long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, and be pursuing original independent research within the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funding to develop and acquire new research skills, methods, or interdisciplinary approaches for UK‑based researchers.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation, must have completed viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, and must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year postdoctoral fellowships to support independent research leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a UK‑based researcher in humanities or social sciences, postdoctoral or above, with at least 20% FTE on award; overseas co‑applicants required.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK‑led interdisciplinary projects with international partners on mobilities, across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin to develop policy‑relevant analysis and networks.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs of applicants or award‑holders, such as equipment, caring costs, or support for application preparation.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers across any career stage in humanities or social sciences, must have prior public engagement experience.
opportunities.summary: Funding for public engagement projects with GLAM or performing arts organisations.
